name: David Xueling Li
forbes_bio: David Xueling Li is cofounder and director of JOYY, a Nasdaq-listed, Singapore-headquartered live streaming and social media platform.
Before cofounding JOYY,  Li was the chief editor at Chinese news portal Netease.com.
Earlier in his career, Li founded CFP.cn, a copyright trading platform for journalists and amateur photographers.

name: Chey Ki-won
forbes_bio: Chey Ki-won is the younger sister of SK Group chairman Chey Tae-Won.
Her stake in SK Holdings accounts for most of her wealth.
She chairs SK's Happiness Sharing Foundation, which conducts educational programs for poor children and sets up and runs social enterprises.
forbes_facts: Since 2006, her Happiness Sharing Foundation has provided more than 40 million lunch boxes to starving children.
The foundation also invests in social entrepreneurship.

name: Liang Guangwei
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes real-time (former) (2023); Forbes annual (2015-2025); Hurun Global (2015-2026); Hurun China (2013-2026)
forbes_bio: Liang Guangwei chairs conglomerate Shenzhen Huaqiang Holdings.
He served in the People's Liberation Army before he received a degree from Shenzhen University.
Huaqiang's businesses range from energy to theme park operation.

name: Claire Bristow
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2025); Hurun Global (2025-2026); SEC insider holdings (2026)
forbes_bio: Claire Bristow is one of four sisters of Frank Holding, Chairman and CEO of First Citizens Bank, a $31 billion (market cap) commercial banking chain, since 2008.
Bristow's grandfather, Robert Powell Holding, became an employee of the bank in 1918, and became president by 1935, before passing it down to Frank's father, Lewis Holding.
Today, Bristow, her three sisters, and her brother Frank collectively own about 20% of the bank.

name: Bachtiar Karim
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2014-2025); Hurun Global (2018-2026)
forbes_bio: Bachtiar Karim or Lim Ek Tjioe is chairman and CEO of Musim Mas Holdings, a Singapore-based integrated palm oil firm that owns operations in Indonesia.
He runs Musim Mas together with his brothers Burhan and Bahari.
His late father Anwar founded Nam Cheong Soap Factory in 1932; the family run operation still makes soaps and margarine.
The family opened the first palm oil refinery in Indonesia in 1970. Musim Mas was formally set up two years later.

name: John Lim
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2024-2025); Hurun Global (2024-2026)
forbes_bio: John Lim cofounded real estate fund manager ARA Asset Management in 2002, at age 45, with the backing of Hong Kong billionaire Li Ka-shing.
In 2016, Lim, along with U.S. private equity firm Warburg Pincus and China's AVIC Trust, took ARA private from the Singapore Stock Exchange in a $1.3 billion buyout.
In 2022, Hong Kong-based real asset manager ESR Group acquired ARA for $5.2 billion in stock and cash.
In 2025, a consortium led by Starwood Capital Group and other investors took ESR private from the Hong Kong stock exchange in a deal that valued it at $7.1 billion.
Lim, who sold out his small stake in ESR Group and resigned from the board, now is the chairman of his JL Family Office.
forbes_facts: He has been the chairman of the Asia Pacific Real Assets Association since 2017.

name: Binny Bansal
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2016-2025); Hurun Global (2016-2026); Hurun India (2016-2019); Hurun Global U40 (2020-2023)
forbes_bio: Former Amazon executive Binny Bansal teamed up with pal Sachin Bansal in 2007 to found Flipkart as an online seller of books, and later grew it into an e-commerce giant.
The duo, who share the same surname but are not related, pooled $6,000 of their combined savings and started operating out of their apartment.
In 2018, Walmart bought a 77% stake in India-based Flipkart for $16 billion in what was reportedly then the world's biggest deal for an internet firm.
In 2023, Bansal sold his remaining 1.8% stake to Walmart in a deal that reportedly valued Flipkart at $35 billion.
He's now chairman of xto10X, an Indian firm that he cofounded with two former Flipkart colleagues, which helps startups scale up their operations.

name: Naresh Trehan
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2024-2025); Hurun Global (2024-2026); Hurun India (2015-2019)
forbes_bio: Naresh Trehan, one of India's top cardiac surgeons, founded the Medanta hospital chain in 2007 with one hospital in Delhi.
He is chairman, managing director and chief cardiac surgeon at Medanta, which offers services across more than 30 specialties including cardiology, neurology and oncology.
Medanta has six hospitals across North India with more than 3,500 hospital beds
He listed Global Health, the parent company of Medanta, on the Indian bourses in 2022.
forbes_facts: Trehan is a recipient of the Padma Bhushan and the Padma Shri, among India's highest civilian honours.
Medanta is building four hospitals including a 400-bed super specialty hospital in south Delhi.

name: Mochtar Riady
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (1996-2025); Hurun Global (2016-2026)
forbes_bio: Mochtar Riady is the founder of the diversified Lippo group, now run by sons James and Stephen.
Born in East Java, Riady opened a bicycle shop at age 22 and went on to build a successful banking career until the 1997 Asian financial crisis.
Today Lippo group's interests include real estate, retail, healthcare, media and education.
Riady's son Stephen runs Singapore property outfit OUE, which until 2020 owned the iconic U.S. Bank Tower in downtown Los Angeles.
Grandson John, an MBA from Wharton, is CEO of listed Lippo Karawaci.
forbes_facts: His daughter Rosy is married to Indonesian billionaire Tahir.

name: Zhou Chengjian
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes real-time (former) (2022); Forbes annual (2001-2025); Hurun Global (2014-2020); Hurun China (2006-2021)
forbes_bio: Zhou Chengjian is the founder of Shanghai Metersbonwe, one of China's largest home-grown apparel chains.
Daughter Hu Jiajia became Metersbonwe chairman in November 2016.
Zhou Chengjian began his career as a tailor.

name: Ruben Vardanyan
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2021-2025); Hurun Global (2023-2026)
forbes_bio: Ruben Vardanyan cofounded investment company Troika Dialog in the early 1990s and is known as the father of the Russian stock market.
In 2013, Vardanyan and his managers sold Troika Dialog to state-owned Sberbank for $1.4 billion.
Vardanyan founded investment boutique Vardanyan, Broitman and partners, which serves ultra high-net-worth individuals, in 2014.
In 2021 he obtained Armenian citizenship and later renounced his Russian citizenship and moved to Armenia.
In November 2022 Vardanyan was appointed the State Minister of Artsakh (Karabakh). He transferred his business assets to the family trust. In February 2023 he dismissed as State Minister.
Vardanyan was arrested by the Azerbaijani State Border Service in 2023 while attempting to enter Armenia; In December 2025, prosecutors requested a life sentence for him.

name: Jean-Marc Chapus
forbes_bio: Jean-Marc Chapus is a managing partner and cofounder of Crescent Capital Group, a Los Angeles-based debt-focused investment firm with $43 billion in assets under management.
He serves on the advisory board of the Milwaukee Brewers, where his Crescent cofounder Mark Attanasio is chairman and principal owner.
Chapus is reported to be a part of the ownership group of the Brewers.
Prior to cofounding Crescent Capital in 1991, Chapus worked at Drexel Burnham Lambert, a pioneer of junk-bond trading.
Chapus also worked as an investment banker at Lehman Brothers in the early 1980s.
forbes_facts: Chapus was a track star while he was a student at Harvard University and captain of the team his senior year.
Chapus has seven children, one of whom ran track at Stanford.
